title: Query Debt Recovery Score By Debtor Party
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM

Entity Type            Service Interface
Category              SAP A2A
Direction         outbound

Query Debt Recovery Score By Debtor Party

Definition

Requesting the debt recovery score for a debtor

Technical Data

Entity Type                                                                         Service Operation
Release State                                                                      not defined

Notes on Release State

Technical Name                                                              CreditAgencyReportERPDebtRecoveryScoreByDebtorPartyQuery_Out
Namespace                                                                        http://sap.com/xi/FICA/Global2 Pe
Application Component                                                         FI-CA
Category                                                                           SAP A2A
Direction                                                                                  outbound
Mode                                                                                       asynchronous
Idempotency                                                                      not applicable
Change/Update Behavior                                                        not applicable
P2P Communication Enabled                                                 no
Features

The debt recovery score gives an assessment of the probability that overdue payments for a collection case assigned to a
collection agency can be collected. It is a separate rating value in addition to the creditworthiness rating (score) from external
credit agencies.

The outbound service operation Query Debt Recovery Score By Debtor Party initiates the query for the debt recovery score for
one or more specified business partners.

The debt recovery score can be used to decide whether to submit items of a business partner to an external collection agency or
to a legal dunning system. The outbound service operation Query Debt Recovery Score By Debtor Party can be used to request
